column1: # CraftCloud admin UI: English catalogue (reference language, ADR-0015).
# Columns: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation. The English source text is the key;
# the context column is empty unless identical source texts need to be told apart.
# Placeholders are written {name} and must appear unchanged in every translation.
# Escapes: \t \n \r \\ . There are no plural forms yet; a count-dependent text must
# be split into separate source texts. `npm run i18n:check` compares all catalogues.
